lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six primary circular high-luminance blobs arranged in a central horizontal row, flanked by parallel secondary rows creating a rectilinear matrix across the mid-body segment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, with primary blobs positioned at the geometric nodes of this lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the lateral flank exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from high-intensity upper edges to low-intensity shadows below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance pixel clusters situated primarily along the anterior margin and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of irregular, small high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
